title: SharePoint: dark mode support in the SharePoint admin center
summary: The roadmap details match, and the searches confirmed the stated documentation gaps. The page nevertheless gives unsupported assurances that dark mode does not affect content, permissions or sharing, and that administrator roles cannot determine its display mode. Licensing should also distinguish the published SharePoint entitlement from unpublished dark-mode-specific terms.

claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because no dark-mode-specific licence has been published.

claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Organisations with Frontline workers need at least one Enterprise user to access the admin center.' In the cost rationale, replace 'licensing for this feature is not yet published' with 'no dark-mode-specific licensing is published'.
